bundle.longDescription: Cowry runs a tool-using agent against any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint, including a local llama.cpp server. Sessions are stored in SQLite with full-text search; commands run inside a bubblewrap sandbox; output includes spreadsheets and documents, not just chat text.
